title.narrative: Educational processes for the exercise of citizenship rights with a gender and generational approach in the municipality of Oruro

description.narrative: Bolivia has some of the highest rates of physical and sexual violence against women and girls in Latin America and the Caribbean. The IAF supports community-led solutions that promote respect for civic and human rights and reduce violence against women and other marginalized groups. Our grantee Foro Ciudadano Articulacin de Mujeres por la Equidad de Gnero e Igualdad (Foro AMUPEI) is a grassroots organization in the municipality of Oruro made up of neighborhood women?s and youth groups that work together to promote and defend the rights of these and other marginalized groups. Foro AMUPUEI is providing training and education for participants as well as conducting awareness-raising events with community leaders government agencies and the general public. Through its Centro Jurdico Integral para la Mujer (CJIM) and public private and university partners Foro AMUPEI is providing integrated legal and psychosocial services to survivors of gender-based violence and abuse. Finally AMUPEI is providing seed capital to promote the economic inclusion and autonomy of marginalized groups and survivors of violence in Oruro.This grant advances the IAF?s strategic initiative to support community-led efforts to mitigate and prevent chronic violence.
